notes.title: DLC “∀kashicbox vol.3” is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Soundtrack DLC is now available![/h1]
Thank you for your patience, we have begun distribution of the DLC “∀kashicbox vol.3”!
If you like the music and atmosphere of ∀stralbringer and want to listen to it outside, we hope you will pick it up!

[h3]∀kashicbox vol.3[/h3]
This is a fan box for “∀stralbringer -Shaded Arkarium-”.
It will be a soundtrack containing all the music used in “∀stralbringer -Shaded Arkarium-”.
For more information, please visit the DLC page below.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432040/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432040/[/url]

Now then, please enjoy!

notes.title: 【Complete Edition】v1.5.0 Release Announcement & Soundtrack Release Notice
notes.content:
Thank you so much for always enjoying our work.

Now, as previously announced, [b]the Complete Edition (Version 1.5.0) is officially released today.[/b]
Thank you for your patience.
[u]This is a "free update,"[/u] so there is no need to purchase any additional DLC.
The update details are as follows:

[h2]【Update Details】[/h2]
[h3]Full Implementation of Another-Simulator[/h3]
[list]
[*]A set of additional stages that become available after clearing Stage 1.
[*]A mode with [b]rules different from the main game.[/b]
[*]It offers a more challenging experience.
[/list]
[h3]Addition of Stage EX-1[/h3]
[list]
[*]This stage is a port of the score-attack stage featured in the [url=https://endless-shirafu.com/stg_caravan_2024/]“Doujin Shooting Game Caravan 2024”[/url] event at DigiGame Expo 2024.
It is unlocked after clearing the main game.
[*]This mode also features slightly different rules from the main game.
[/list]
[h3]Addition of "Touring Play" Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Play through Stages 1 to 3 in one go[/b]—a so-called arcade like mode.
It is an extra element unlocked after clearing the main game.
This mode is for those seeking an additional challenge.
[/list]
[h3]Steam Achievements Support[/h3]
[list]
[*]Steam achievements are now supported.
If you have the skill to clear the main game and Another-Simulator,
you should be able to unlock all achievements naturally.
Please give it a try and aim for 100% completion.
[/list]
[h3]Steam Leaderboards Support[/h3]
[list]
[*]Leaderboards are available for each mode in Another-Simulator.
Be sure to check the rankings as well.
[/list]

Overall, the endgame content has been significantly expanded.
We hope you enjoy it!


[h2]【About the Soundtrack Release】[/h2]
To commemorate the release of the Complete Edition, we plan to release the game's original soundtrack,
[b]“∀kashicbox vol.3”[/b], around mid-January.
We will make an announcement as soon as it is available.
If you're interested, we hope you'll consider picking up a copy.

-----------------------------------------
We managed to release the Complete Edition just in time for the end of the year...
We believe that reaching this milestone is thanks to everyone's support and encouragement.
Thank you so much.
(We apologize once again for the repeated delays…)

We are always open to bug reports and translation improvement suggestions.
Please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1863300/discussions/0/5617721963176518947/]Bug Report Thread[/url].

Wishing you a Happy New Year!
We look forward to your continued support next year as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257766/6ca680490f4a83f6f92d8f4c7bbfc9b0f9149ad4.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Information for September 24, 2024 (Version 1.1.0beta)
notes.content:
Thank you very much for always enjoying our work.

As we informed you the other day, we will be updating to version 1.1.0beta today. This update includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Addition of the initial version of the new stage
[*] Support for language switching (Note: English translation is partially incomplete)
[*] Addition and update of new background music
[*] Fixes for minor bugs
[*] Added facial expression variations in dialogues
[*] Adjustments to some boss attacks
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy these updates.

If you encounter any issues, please continue to report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1863300/discussions/0/5617721963176518947/]Bug Report Thread[/url] within our community.

Thank you once again for your continued support.

notes.title: Update on the Full Version Release and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Update on the Full Version Release and Upcoming Updates

We have decided to postpone the release of the full version, which includes English translation, to August. We deeply apologize to those who have been eagerly awaiting the English version.

Originally, we planned to release the completed version, supporting only English, between February and March. However, we have felt a strong desire to further enrich the full version. To fulfill this, we have decided to implement a new stage, making the full version even more comprehensive.

This new stage is not a DLC. Those who have already purchased the Early Access version will be provided with an update to the full version free of charge.

Furthermore, in addition to the full version's release, we plan to release the game's soundtrack as a DLC.

We apologize for the wait and appreciate your patience until the release of the completed version. Please bear with us a little longer.

notes.title: v1.0.1(BugFix)
notes.content:

notes.title: Current progress and plans to participate in future events
notes.content:
Hello, This is Nicolai, the developer of Endless Shirafu.
This will be my first update in about 3 months.

The other day, we exhibited at "[url=https://digigame-expo.org/]Digigame Expo 2023[/url]"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42257766/23e9a307da8b829719a3590a7dcbe2ac9395f502.jpg[/img].

As for progress, the only thing left to do as far as making stages for the game is the implementation of the 3-sided boss.
The story is a total of 3 stages.

As for stage 3, it currently looks like the one below.

[previewyoutube=ppj52h23oEk;full]Stage 3 video[/previewyoutube].
Conversations have also been implemented in the existing stages.
There is quite a lot of text.

Stage 3 was exhibited at the Digigame Expo 2023.
The following is a list of our future plans.

[list]
[*] 2023/12/31 [url=https://t.co/AP2NrFui0O]Comic Market 103, Sunday, East S-17b[/url] ←[b]★ Japanese version completed and physical package distributed[/b].
[*] 2024/01/20/21 at Tokyo Game Dungeon 4 ← Will distribute here as well.
[*] Other events undecided (some events have already been applied for).
[/list]

We will first distribute the [b]physical package[/b] version at Comic Market 103.
After that, we hope to release a brushed-up version with English support, bug fixes, difficulty adjustment, etc. on Steam near the end of February/March 2024.
Thank you for your patience.

The physical package version will be distributed mainly at comic markets and physical events.
Since this is a physical version, it will have a premium and heavy feel, We are planning to make it a [b]collector's item[/b] that you can enjoy.
We hope you will come to the event and pick up a physical package version.

Well, that's about it for now!
